subject: English
question_text: Choose the best answer from the alternatives.
stimulus: a. Why did the man feel happy? i) For getting job ii) For letting a job iii) For leaving a job iv) For making his last job b. Why did the man dislike his last job? i) It was hard ii) It was boring iii) It was a desk job iv) It was an official job c. When did he decide to leave his job? i) After around two years ii) After more than two years iii) After less than two years iv) After getting salary d. His job is now connected with ----. i) driving ii) nature iii) morning iv) winter e. When does he get up in summer? i) Earlier ii) Later than winter iii) At moonlit night iv) About 7 am f. What makes him busy now? i) Timber ii) Medicinal plants iii) His previous job iv) Flower garden g. Why does he himself cook his own food? i) Since he is unmarried ii) As he wants to be married iii) As he is a good man iv) Since he has no job Extra Practices h. Where does he go at weekends? i) In other countries ii) In village area iii) In city area iv) In a beautiful place i. Why does he not watch TV? i) Because he has no TV ii) As he has no money iii) Since he collects stamps iv) Because it is his hobby j. He is happy because he ---- to run a decent life. i) can earn vast money ii) can earn enough money iii) has to earn enough money iv) is unable
guide_solution: a. iii) For leaving a job; b. ii) It was boring; c. i) After around two years; d. nature; e.i) Earlier than winter; f. ii) Medicinal plants; g. i) Since he is unmarried; h. ii) In village area; i. i) Because he has no TV; j. ii) can earn enough money.

subject: English
stimulus: a. What was the reason behind the happiness of the man? b. Why did the man decide to leave the job? c. When does he start work? d. Is the man happy now? e. Why are his friends not happy? Extra Practices f. Who are professionals? g. From where does he collect unknown saplings? h. What is his hobby? i. When does he become busier than the normal time? j. What is the passage about?
guide_solution: a. The reason behind the happiness of the man was losing his last job. b. The man decided to leave the job because he never liked his job. c. He starts work very early. d. Yes, the man is happy now. He left his boring job. So, he is happy now. e. His friends are not happy to see him in rustic life. f. His friends are professionals. g. He collects unknown saplings from countryside. h. His hobby is collecting stamps. i. He becomes busier than the normal time in the winter and the rain. j. The passage is about a freedom loving man.
